## DELETE `/api/instances/hostInitiator/{id}`

**Tier:** T3  

Delete a host initiator and all of its paths from the host . This removes host access from the initiator to the system . To reuse the initiator, you must use modify method to associate it a host .

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Unique identifier of the hostInitiator instance. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

|---|---|---|
| `force` | boolean | Specifies whether to force deletion of this host initiator. If the initiator is stale but the associated host still has lun access, the delete of the initiator will fail, as will deletes of the accessible luns. The… |

**Responses:** `204` No Content
